prompt.v: Which study could show whether fertilizer affects plant height?

problems.text: design for cause (fertilizer): options a=experiment, b=records, c=survey

options.label: Randomly assign amounts of fertilizer, then measure the plant height and compare them.
Look up past records of fertilizer and plant height, and compare them.
Randomly choose people, ask about their fertilizer and plant height, and find the correlation.

problems.explain: Only random assignment makes the groups alike in everything except fertilizer, so a difference in plant height can be put down to it. (A survey or old records, however large and however randomly the people are chosen, only show that the two go together: something else could drive both.) So the experiment that randomly assigns fertilizer.
